newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Summers urges growth measures in Europe, Japan.
newsitem.headline: Summers urges growth measures in Europe, Japan.

text.p: U.S. deputy Treasury secretary Lawrence Summers urged Europe and Japan on Saturday to boost growth by stimulating demand and continuing structural reforms.
Summers told a news conference at the World Economic Forum that Washington was watching closely the economic situation in Europe and Japan.
"In both Europe and Japan, it is important that demand be stimulated at a level that makes possible economic growth," he said.
"It is also important that there be strong and continuing structural reforms," he added.
Summers said structural reforms in Europe should include deregulation, allowing more job creation.
In Japan, Summers said reforms needed to "promote competition and openess in product markets".
